title: If faces (ogres/people) look too similar in Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, add…
content: If faces (ogres/people) look too similar in Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, add clearer, more specific instructions describing distinct facial features for each character to increase variation.
tips: If faces (ogres/people) look too similar in Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, add clearer, more specific instructions describing distinct facial features for each character to increase variation.

es.content: Si los rostros (ogros/personas) se ven demasiado similares en Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, añade instrucciones más claras y específicas que describan rasgos faciales distintos para cada personaje para aumentar la variación.

fr.content: Si les visages (ogres/personnes) se ressemblent trop dans Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, ajoutez des instructions plus claires et plus précises décrivant des traits du visage distincts pour chaque personnage afin d’augmenter la variation.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5 の text-to-video で顔（オーガ／人間）があまりにも似通って見える場合は、各キャラクターの明確で具体的な顔の特徴を説明する、よりはっきりした指示を追加して、バリエーションを増やしてください。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5의 text-to-video에서 얼굴(오우거/사람)이 너무 비슷하게 보인다면, 각 캐릭터의 뚜렷한 얼굴 특징을 더 명확하고 구체적으로 설명하는 지시를 추가해 다양성을 높이세요.

pt.content: Se os rostos (ogros/pessoas) estiverem muito parecidos no text-to-video do Seedance 2.5, adicione instruções mais claras e específicas descrevendo características faciais distintas de cada personagem para aumentar a variação.

zh.content: 如果在 Seedance 2.5 文生视频中，面孔（食人魔/人物）看起来过于相似，可以添加更清晰、更具体的指令，描述每个角色各自独特的面部特征，以增加差异性。
